description.subtitle: Short pants of the second adidas equipment of Real Madrid 2026 2027 - dark green
description.tagline: Complete the second equipment of Real Madrid
description.intro: The short adidas 2nd Real Madrid 26 27 completes the club’s visiting uniform with a design inspired by Madrid’s elegance and history. Equipped with CLIMACOOL technology, it offers freshness and comfort to perform to the fullest in and out of the playing field.
key_benefits: CLIMATE: Evacuate sweat to keep skin fresh and dry.
Elastic waistband with cord: Safe and personalized fit.
Light fabric: Promotes freedom of movement during play.
Official design: Inspired by the second equipment of Real Madrid 2026 2027.

Cintura elástica con cordón: Ajuste seguro y personalizado.
